title: Graph schema introspection tool (get_graph_schema)

pipelineStages.summary: Spec: read-only get_graph_schema MCP tool enumerating node-type counts + property keys, edge-type counts, and relationship patterns from the existing graph store.
5-task TDD plan: test-first, implement aggregation, wire registration, docs+changeset, validate.
TDD implementation + registration in server.ts, index.ts, capability declarations.

localChecks.registered: confirmed — get_graph_schema present in getToolDefinitions() served list (106 tools) with wired handler

assumptions: Tool named get_graph_schema to match repo get_*/query_* graph-tool naming.
'Property definitions' = observed union of property KEYS per label (top-level set GraphNode fields + metadata keys); key names only, since metadata is untyped Record<string,unknown>.
Owning package for changeset is @harness-engineering/cli; minor bump (new MCP tool = new feature).
Output shape { nodeTypes:[{label,count,properties}], edgeTypes:[{type,count}], patterns:[{from,edge,to,count}], totals:{nodeCount,edgeCount} }.
Edges whose endpoints are absent from the node set are grouped under sentinel label 'unknown' so pattern counts reconcile with edgeCount.
Change-dir slug is graph-schema-introspection (no feat- prefix) to match existing docs/changes/* convention; git branch is feat/graph-schema-introspection.
